blocks.text: Terms of Use samajhna kai wajah se zaroori hai:

items: Protection of Rights (haq ki hifazat): Terms of Use user ke rights batati hain, jaise privacy ka haq, ek khaas level ki service milne ka haq, aur kuch ghalat ho jaye to redress (nuqsan ka badla ya shikayat ka hal) maangne ka haq. Misal: Pakistan mein Foodpanda jaisi food delivery service ki Terms of Use batati hain ke agar aap ka order ghalat aaye ya delivery der se ho to kya hoga.

Clarity and Transparency (baat saaf hona aur kuch na chhupana): Yeh terms saaf batati hain ke user service se kya umeed rakhe: provider kya dega, kin sharton par dega, aur kaun se kaam mana hain. Is se ghalat fehmi nahi hoti aur user soch samajh kar faisla karta hai. Misal: Agar hum mobile phone se paise bhejte ya lete hain to Terms of Use transaction limits (len den ki hadd), fees, aur unauthorized (baghair ijazat) transactions ki report karne ka tareeqa batati hain.

Legal Safeguards (qanooni hifazat): Business (karobar) ke liye Terms of Use un ki services ke ghalat istemal ke khilaf hifazat hain. Yeh hadein (limits) tay karti hain ta ke agar user rules na maane to company legal masle (qanooni pareshani) se bachi rahe. Misal: Pakistani online education platform yeh shart rakh sakta hai ke course ka content ijazat ke baghair share na kiya jaye, ta ke us ki intellectual property (us ki banai hui cheez) mehfooz rahe.

blocks.prompt: Users ke liye Terms of Use samajhna kyun zaroori hai? (Short question 1)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh user ke rights batati hain (privacy, service ka darja, kuch ghalat ho to shikayat aur nuqsan ka badla), saaf batati hain ke service kya degi, kin sharton par aur kya mana hai, aur fees ya len den ki hadein bhi batati hain. Is se ghalat fehmi aur legal pareshani se bachao hota hai aur user soch samajh kar faisla karta hai ke service istemal kare ya nahi. Provider ke liye yeh ghalat istemal ke khilaf legal hifazat hain.

items: Teen faide: rights ki hifazat (Foodpanda), clarity aur transparency (mobile payments), business ki legal hifazat (online education platform).
